name: MoveInOutInspection
tagline: Room-by-room check-in vs check-out inspections with wear-and-tear vs damage, charges and tenant sign-off.
description: A complete end-of-tenancy inspection app for Power Apps and Power Pages: dashboard and pipeline, inspection list, room-by-room move-in vs move-out comparison with 1-5 ratings and suggested classification, charges, add/edit form with validation, status workflow with business rules, condition statement with tenant signature and dispute handling. Works instantly with demo data and binds to any collection, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel or SQL table.
features: Demo mode with fictional sample data
Move-in vs move-out ratings per item with change delta
Charges with rules (no charge for wear and tear)
Status workflow with validation and bulk advance
Tenant signature pad or typed signature
Undo, confirmations, read-only and disabled states
Phone bottom bar and stacked cards
Power Fx outputs and OnSave/OnCreate/OnStatusChange/OnAction events
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
